name: The Rectory

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Rectory stands close to St Andrew's, where the parish priests lived for centuries.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Please look from the road: it is a private house.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Hal the castle keeper swears he was asleep in the rectory loft, guarding the parson's horses. The groom agrees.]]

evidence: [[c:Hal the castle keeper was asleep in the rectory loft all night.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Follow the lane round to the west and north along Well Lane to Barnwell Castle. About 460 metres.]]
